## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass (`make test`)
- [ ] Lint passes (`make lint` and `make lint-py`)
- [ ] Added / updated tests for new behaviour
- [ ] Docs updated if public API changed
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md entry added (under `[Unreleased]`)

## For reviewers

Merge once:

- [ ] CI is green (Python matrix + coverage, lint, frontend)
- [ ] Change is covered by tests, or the **How to test** steps were verified
- [ ] Scope matches the summary — no unrelated drive-by changes
- [ ] CHANGELOG + docs updated where the change is user-facing
